attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to ending violence against women wherever it occurs—in homes, streets, schools, the military, or elsewhere.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to support the Violence Against Women Act to provide law enforcement with tools to combat violence against women.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support comprehensive services for survivors of violence.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase prevention efforts in communities and on campuses.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to end sexual assault wherever it occurs, including on campuses.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Everyone deserves a safe environment where they can learn and thrive, not live in fear.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will provide comprehensive support to survivors of sexual assault.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure a fair process for all on-campus disciplinary proceedings and in the criminal justice system related to sexual assault.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase sexual violence prevention education programs that cover issues like consent and bystander intervention in college and secondary school.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
